basic_details.job_title: CEC Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 4 Computer Programme Assistant, Producer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Consortium for Educational Communication (CEC), an autonomous body under the University Grants Commission (UGC), is filling four posts on deputation basis under Advt. No. CEC/8/2026 dated 21 November 2026: Joint Director (Hardware), Chief Administrative Officer, Producer and Computer Programme Assistant, one post each. Only officers of Central or State Governments, Union Territory Administrations, Public Sector Undertakings, Universities, recognised institutes and research institutions, and autonomous or statutory organisations will be considered. Applications go by e-mail to [email protec

age_limit.details: For all four posts, the maximum age limit for appointment by deputation is not exceeding Fifty-Six (56) years as on the last date of receipt of applications. A candidate already in service will be eligible for age relaxation as per Rules, and relaxation as permissible under Government of India Rules will apply.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be made in the prescribed Application Format (Annexure-I), which is printed with the notice and can also be downloaded from www.cec.nic.in . It must be sent through proper channel with the forwarding certificate from the Head of Office (Annexure-II). An applicant may send an advance copy directly to CEC, provided a formal copy is also submitted through the proper channel (Parent Office) before the last date. Separate applications may be forwarded for each post.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational qualification: Engineering Degree in Electronics / Electrical and Electronics / Computer Engineering / Electronics and Communication / Information Technology from a recognized Institute / University, OR Master's Degree in Electronics / Information Technology / Telecommunication from a recognized University / Institution. Experience: at least 12 years in a broadcasting organization for Radio and Television, of which 8 years should be in a Television organization in Maintenance, Installation, System Design and planning of TV, Studio / AV Studio / Multimedia Studio and Telecasting / Net / web casting facilities using new Information Communication Technology (ICT). Deputation eligibility: (a) officers from Central / State Governments, Universities, Autonomous Bodies, Professional and Research Institutions (i) holding analogous post on regular basis, or (ii) with five years regular service in Pay Level-12 of Rs.78,800 – 2,09,200/-; and (b) possessing the qualification prescribed for direct recruitment above. Master Degree with 55% marks, with 5 years' experience in Pay Level-11 of Rs.67,700-2,08,700/- in personnel / purchase and stores / accounts / finance department in a University / Government / Autonomous Body. Five years continuous regular service in Pay Level-11 of Rs.67,700-2,08,700/- as Assistant Registrar or Under Secretary or equivalent post, with experience in personnel / purchase and stores / accounts / finance department in a University / Government / Autonomous Body. Must have knowledge and skill of use of office application on computer. Master's Degree in any subject with at least 55% marks; or Bachelor's Degree in Engineering with three years experience in Video Production or Direction, preferably in Educational TV; or PG Diploma in direction from FTII or equivalent qualifications; or Master in Communication with two years experience in Video Production, preferably in Educational TVs. Graduate in Science / Commerce with 55% marks and the certificate or diploma in Computer applications from an institution of repute. Experience: at least two years experience of using PC and familiarity of using programmes like dBase, Fox Pro, Quattro, Lotus, etc. Desirable: knowledge of writing / developing software. For all four posts, the maximum age limit for appointment by deputation is not exceeding Fifty-Six (56) years as on the last date of receipt of applications. A candidate already in service will be eligible for age relaxation as per Rules, and relaxation as permissible under Government of India Rules will apply. Only applications of officers / officials of the Central Government, State Governments, Union Territory Administration, Public Sector Undertakings, Universities, Recognised Institutes, Recognised Research Institutions, Autonomous Organizations and Statutory Organisations who meet the eligibility criteria and experience for the post will be considered. Applicants should be those whose services could be spared immediately on

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Prescribed application proforma (Annexure-I), filled and signed, with a self-attested passport size photograph. Certificate from the forwarding authority in proforma Annexure-II. Cadre Clearance Certificate from the Parent Department. Vigilance Clearance and Integrity Certificate. Attested copies of the last five years of APARs / ACRs. Statement of major penalties imposed in the last ten years (if applicable). Self-attested copies of certificates / testimonials for qualification, experience, date of birth and caste certificate in prescribed format. At the time of interview, in-service candidates must produce the No Objection Certificate from the employer, failing which they shall not be interviewed. They should also submit a certificate from the employer or an authorized officer that no disciplinary case is pending or contemplated against them, and furnish the Vigilance Clearance Report.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is by short-listing followed by an interview. Only short-listed candidates will be called for the interview, and submission of an application does not confer any right to be called. If the response is exceptionally high, CEC reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called for interview to those having a higher percentage of marks in the requisite qualification. Merely possessing the prescribed qualification and requisite experience would not entitle a candidate to be called for an interview. The decision of the Selection Committee shall be final. No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the Written Test / Skill Test / Interview, as the case may be.

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: If the closing date is a holiday, the next working day will be treated as the last date. Incomplete applications and applications received after the due date will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CEC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies, one post each of Joint Director (Hardware), Chief Administrative Officer, Producer and Computer Programme Assistant, all on deputation basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for CEC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach CEC within 30 days from the date of advertisement (21 November 2026), which is about 21 December 2026. If the closing date is a holiday, the next working day is the last date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Computer Programme Assistant post?
faq.answer: A Graduate in Science / Commerce with 55% marks and a certificate or diploma in Computer applications from an institution of repute, with at least two years experience of using PC and familiarity with programmes like dBase, Fox Pro, Quattro and Lotus.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for CEC deputation posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is not exceeding 56 years as on the last date of receipt of applications; in-service candidates are eligible for age relaxation as per Rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for each post?
faq.answer: Joint Director (Hardware) gets Pay Level-13 (Rs.1,23,100 - 2,15,900/-), Chief Administrative Officer Pay Level-12 (Rs.78,800 - 2,09,200/-), Producer Pay Level-10 (Rs.56,100 - 1,77,500/-) and Computer Programme Assistant Pay Level-06 (Rs.35,400 - 1,12,400/-), as per the 7th CPC.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for CEC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send the filled Annexure-I with the Annexure-II forwarding certificate and enclosures by e-mail to [email protected], and send the hard copy through proper channel to the Administrative Officer (Admin.), CEC, IUAC Campus, Aruna Asaf Ali Marg, New Delhi – 110067.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Applications are short-listed and only short-listed candidates are called for an interview; CEC may restrict the number called to those with a higher percentage of marks in the requisite qualification.

faq.question: Q8. Who can apply for these CEC posts?
faq.answer: Only officers of Central or State Governments, UT Administration, PSUs, Universities, recognised institutes and research institutions, and autonomous or statutory organisations who meet the eligibility criteria for the post.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the deputation period?
faq.answer: The deputation is for an initial period of one year, which may be extended further as per requirements, and may be terminated earlier at the discretion of CEC.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice says separate applications may be forwarded for each post.
